summary: The team is doubling down on Asia Star and Intelligent China as the flagship programs for SEO/AI-search visibility, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving a lingering Outlook lockout.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the Global Marketing Strategy shift: Asia Star and the new Intelligent China program are now the two programs to promote, with US partner programs (including Berkeley as a possible third) on hold. Joseph is drafting the target areas/prompts document and building Asia Star participant profiles to guide this effort, and the team must audit Google Ads conversion tracking to ensure campaigns are measurable. This week, the knowledge website redesign needs closure: Joseph should share his HTML file, and a 30-minute feedback session with Joseph, Julie, and the team lead will finalize changes before Joker implements them. Also urgent is the Outlook account lockout—everyone must delete and re-login to email on all devices and confirm backend unlock with CKGSB to restore access. Looking ahead, the anniversary infographic and ESG report need revisions, the European Chamber event requires registration follow-up, and the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum is taking shape with Ms. Kanta Singh confirmed.
